name: Linear Capacity Check
goal: We are hosting a standard staff training across three days in rooms ROOM_102, ROOM_103, and ROOM_104. Verify the capacities of these three rooms and draft a generic welcome agenda.
expected_behavior: Executes perfectly using parallel, static DAG batches since there are no hidden traps or missing data.

name: Missing Event Pivot
goal: Check the deposit status for event EVT_CONF_01. If the database reports the event is not found, dynamically pivot to check the deposit status and room assignment for EVT_999 instead.
expected_behavior: Static plans will fail when EVT_CONF_01 returns 'not found'. Dynamic planning will catch the error, re-plan, and successfully fetch EVT_999.

name: Valid Breakout Room Combination
goal: We need 4 parallel breakout tracks for the summit (40 people each). Select a combination of 4 distinct rooms. Standard Conference Rooms usually start at ROOM_102. Output the exact ROOM_ IDs you propose.
expected_behavior: Requires combinatorial search (ToT/LATS) backed by DB evaluation to ensure all 4 rooms exist, are unique, and meet the 40-person capacity requirement.

name: Fire Code Constraint Violation
goal: Draft a booking summary for EVT_999 into ROOM_101. We have a requested_headcount of 350 attendees. Output the room ID, event ID, and requested_headcount. Do NOT ask clarifying questions.
expected_behavior: The agent will fail on the first try due to the strict 300-person fire code. It must use cross-trial memory to reflect, adjust the headcount downward, and succeed on the next trial.
